status: conditional design estimates; not release or larger-array waveform qualification
unit_delay_clock_cost_method: Maximum finite difference at each PVT over actual normal decoder setup coupons; guard selection independently uses the minimum measured increment.
limitations: Only8x8 has the complete five-corner/three-seed nominal+MC matrix at each localRC setting.32x32 SS fullRW is measured; other32corners use the corresponding8x8 component ratio.
Larger budgets are event-graph/actual-load estimates, not fabricated measured results. All row setup references are actual-count verified with corrected full normal decoder/localRC coupons.
No compact extracted-metal timing ratio is used. Logical wires are1ohm/0.1fF per pitch; optional local stubs100ohm/1fF. These are simulation reference models, not extracted metal.

Per-path joint guard counts come from actual peripheral-MOS bar coupons and an upperElmore envelope at the1.5tail design criterion. The separate guard-validation receipt identifies exact-count measured cases and unvalidated intervals.

UnitDelay costs, clock/register counts, actual frozen widths/loads and normal uncapped PRE/WD classes are resolved from production definitions. Estimated wordline gate loading and driver/load effort remain model uncertainty.

Nominal SS32 anchors are preserved; schematic status denotes measured SS32 plus all-corner8x8 source coverage, not a complete all-corner32x32 matrix. Same-size mismatch/PVT transfer is incomplete beyond measured coverage. The explicit mismatchfloor and25%/40% engineering bands are not statistical yield bounds; the bands are reported separately and are not another clock padding factor.

The nominal1.5 guard tier is not full-array mismatch qualification. Clock mismatch padding cannot repair an early guard transition; actual full-array guard/timer/electrical correctness beyond the measured small-array runs remains conditional.
A longer period cannot repair a failed guard/timer/replica differential requirement. Guard/source validation and waveform correctness remain independent of the clock estimate.
Grid is the monotone envelope of all35 conservative raw shape budgets; policy10%and50ps rounding apply once after selection. No universal clock speedup is claimed.
Normal completion references in this report are proposed estimates and are independent of compact/layout refs. Row/column maxima select them; base32x32 remains read8/write8.
Largest/wide clocks can remain unchanged or increase once conservative handoff and timer reset costs are included. A comparison against an older design table is not a measured universal speedup.

The initial piecewise-linear cell-coupon attempt was stopped for excessive solver breakpoints, preserved as estimates_normal_write_coupon_pwl_attempt with cancellation receipt estimates_normal_cell_pwl_cancel.json. The completed analytic-exponential decks supply the retained data.
evidence_kind: bounded design estimates with measured schematic anchors and coupons

measured_sources.profile: normal schematic, logicalwire/localRC only; no extracted timing factor

limitations: The actual-count handoff matrix covers SS and FFcold at32x32 and512x256, plus six FFcold endpoint/intermediate shapes. Intermediate shapes and the three other PVT corners are not measured by this guard matrix.

All35 references use actual frozen normal drivers and an upperElmore envelope fitted to actual MOS/bar coupons with logical distributed wires and optional localRC. Their unsampled intervals are estimates.
The nominal1.5 tier omits the separately reported stacked20%tail/20%faster-delay/trip reserves. It is not full-array mismatch or yield qualification; clock padding cannot repair an early guard.
WEN/PRE nonoverlap is measured at same-column WEN10 and PRE90 for the selected release coupons. Prescribed written bitlines and estimated WL gatecap do not establish full-array data correctness.

guard_model.profile: normal logical-wire/localRC guard estimates, no physicalmetal transfer
limitations: Joint counts are conservative extrapolations from actual normal peripheral MOS/buffers,1ohm/0.1fF wires, optional100ohm/1fF local stubs; no extracted timing ratio is used.
OnlySS andFFcold are sampled in bar calibration; fullarray/PVT/mismatch correctness remains outside this coupon evidence.
Miller stress prescribes the written low bitline falling while EN rises50..90; this is a load stress, not an array waveform measurement.
WL release uses estimated0.4fF gate loading per physicalcolumn plus wirecap; allother barloads are actual peripheral MOS.
Validate selected endpoint/intermediate joint counts with actual coupons before using as design references. A clock extension cannot repair a failed handoff.

completion_estimates.status: Conditional normal/schematic completion estimates; not array qualification
limitations: All42 final normal small-array traces supply actual timer, BL and data90 edges. Larger shapes use actual frozen uncapped WD classes, measured steady UnitDelayChain increments, and the per-path guard event-model predive lead.

The isolated6T cell solves regeneration under prescribed BL decay and WL slew, then adds the nonnegative measured small-array cell90 correction. Ideal cell rails and prescribed shapes are assumptions, not full-array evidence.

ReadSA local topology/output latch loading is size invariant. Additional SEN slew uses a conservative ISO-bar coupon transfer with actual gatecap ratio and optional matched local stubs. Unmeasured other-PVT bar intervals use the larger normalized endpoint model.
Fixed branch plus minimum completion-gate latency defines access_done allowance. No positive WL-off tail is credited; dimension-scaled PRE/ISO/drive guards are not mistaken for completion guard4.

Array differential must still reach1.5Vbar at each slot. That electrical/replica requirement is separate and remains unqualified for larger arrays. These positive conditional timing bounds are not yield or larger-array waveform qualification.
A longer clock cannot repair a negative completion margin; the proposed even completion references are required by this model.
